1.en_consolidated_definition:
Throat 

Neck of the larynx or pharynx.

In Puerto Rican Spanish, this term may also refer to the "garganta" or throat area in a traditional Puerto Rican dish called "arroz con gandules y gandulete de la garganta", which is a type of rice and pigeon pea stew.
